newsitem.title: USA: Guidant acquires development stage company.
newsitem.headline: Guidant acquires development stage company.

text.p: Guidant Corp said Wednesday it acquired NeoCardia LLC a privately held development-stage company in Houston, Texas that pioneered the use of radiation therapy for the treatment of restenosis.

Guidant will pay as much as $77 million in cash for NeoCardia, as well as subsequent additional bonus and royalty payments contingent upon achieving certain product development and sales goals, Guidant said.
NeoCardia currently does not have any products available for commercial sale.
Shares of medical device company Guidant were down 1/8 at 69-7/8.
